value.rationale: The claim is motivated by contrasting regular versus Poisson orientation renewal for an active particle in a harmonic trap. It reveals a previously unlocated negative–positive–negative covariance sequence from competition of common random phase and negative spherical angular contractions, which is invisible in ordinary position covariance. The exact formula, rigorously sufficient dimension and strict sign witness provide a reproducible benchmark and counterexample to extrapolating the Poisson one-crossing picture.
